in_hebrew.name: Gerdi
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gerdi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German words 'ger' (spear) and 'thiud' (people). This name is believed to mean 'spear weaver'.

in_greek.name: Gerdi
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Spear Weaver
in_greek.long_meaning: Gerdi είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old High German words 'ger' (spear) and 'thiud' (people). This name is believed to mean 'spear weaver'.

in_latin.name: Gerdi
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Spear Weaver
in_latin.long_meaning: Gerdi est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old High German words 'ger' (spear) and 'thiud' (people). This name is believed to mean 'spear weaver'.
